title: 第5章 炼化妖丹可以交流的武魂第6章 以势压人废其左手
content_zh:
待叶无尘将众人的储物袋都搜刮干净之后，那群弟子便争先恐后的离开了此地。
“把那个昏死的家伙也给带出去。”
叶无尘吆喝了一声。
待众人离开，叶无尘转过头看向叶夕月，脸上带着一抹灿烂的笑意。
“这群弟子身上的资源还不少嘛。”
活脉草、鸟翎花、兰月草、天心竹...虽然都是些低阶灵药。
但架不住数量可观呐，这些草药加起来也能卖个几十枚金币。
要知道，武安城中许多百姓半年的收入估计也就两三枚金币罢了。
甚至叶林的储物袋中竟然还有一枚炼体五重妖兽的妖丹。
妖丹不同于灵药灵草，想要获取妖丹，就必须要猎杀妖兽。
妖丹中含有大量的气血之力，是炼制淬体丹的主要材料之一。
因此，妖丹在武安城可是个硬通货，不论在哪都能卖出一个好价钱。
就在叶无尘把玩着手中那枚通红色妖丹的时候，他的内心深处竟涌现出一股渴望的情绪。
“怎么回事，为什么我会突然生出一种想要当场吃掉这颗妖丹的想法？”
“不对，这好像不是我的情绪。”
叶无尘闭上双眼，此时的他能隐约的感觉到。
这股渴望的情绪似乎不是来自他自身，而是——魂宫！
为了搞清楚情绪的来源，叶无尘心神遁入魂宫之中。
他的脚下，那株幼嫩的树苗不停的摇曳着自己的枝叶，叶无尘脑海中的渴望感也越来越强烈。
“是你想要那颗妖丹？”

叶无尘诧异看向脚下的树苗，自言自语道。
可没想到的是，树苗竟真的回应了叶无尘的话语。
它的枝干开始上下摆动，就像是在点头一般。
“你能听的懂我说的话？”
叶无尘看到这一幕十分惊奇，他从来没有听说过武魂竟然还能交流。
那树苗见状又上下晃了晃自己的枝叶，表示赞同。
“那我该怎么做？”
叶无尘又问了一句。
树苗似乎不知道该怎么告诉叶无尘，只能一味在摆动自己的枝干。
同时释放出越来越强烈的渴望情绪。
随后叶无尘又询问了树苗几个问题。
可树苗依旧只是不停的摆动着枝干，似乎已经无法交流。
见无法问出什么有用的东西出来，他便将心神退出了魂宫之中。
回到现实，叶无尘看着手上的妖丹，内心思索着什么。
魂宫之中，那株树苗依旧在释放着渴望的情绪。
“难道是要炼化？”
叶无尘猜测道。
话音落下，他体内的树苗竟释放出了一股喜悦的情绪，似乎是在认可刚刚叶无尘的话语。
“还真是要炼化。”
叶无尘有些震惊。

虽然妖丹中储存着大量的气血之力，但一般情况下没有武者会选择炼化妖丹中的气血之力。
妖丹中所蕴含气血之力十分狂暴，因此炼化妖丹的效率十分之低。
往往一颗妖丹能吸收两成的气血之力就已经算是不错了。
但最重要的还是因为，妖丹中的气血之力往往都伴随着妖毒。
若是想要吸收炼化妖丹，必定会将妖毒吸入体内。
content_en:
After Ye Wuchen plundered everyone's storage bags, the group of disciples rushed to leave the place.
"Take that unconscious guy out too."
Ye Wuchen shouted.
After everyone left, Ye Wuchen turned his head and looked at Ye Xiyue with a bright smile on his face.
"These disciples have quite a lot of resources."
Living Vein Grass, Bird Feather Flower, Orchid Moon Grass, Tianxin Bamboo... although they are all low-level elixirs.
But the quantity is huge, these herbs together can be sold for dozens of gold coins.
You know, the income of many people in Wu'an City for half a year is estimated to be only two or three gold coins.
There was even a demon pill for refining a fifth-level demon beast in Ye Lin's storage bag.
Demon elixirs are different from elixirs and herbs. If you want to obtain demon elixirs, you must hunt demon beasts.
The demon pill contains a large amount of energy and blood, and is one of the main materials for refining the body tempering pill.
Therefore, demon pills are a hard currency in Wu'an City and can be sold at a good price no matter where they are.
Just when Ye Wuchen was playing with the red demon pill in his hand, a feeling of desire emerged deep in his heart.
"What's going on? Why did I suddenly have the idea of eating this demon pill on the spot?"
"No, this doesn't seem to be my emotion."
Ye Wuchen closed his eyes, and he could vaguely feel it at this time.
This longing didn't seem to come from himself, but from the Soul Palace!
In order to understand the source of his emotions, Ye Wuchen mentally escaped into the Soul Palace.
Under his feet, the young sapling kept swaying its branches and leaves, and the desire in Ye Wuchen's mind became stronger and stronger.
"Do you want that demon pill?"
Ye Wuchen looked at the saplings at his feet in surprise and said to himself.
But what I didn't expect was that the sapling actually responded to Ye Wuchen's words.
Its branches began to move up and down, as if nodding.
"Can you understand what I say?"
Ye Wuchen was very surprised when he saw this scene. He had never heard that martial spirits could communicate.
Seeing this, the sapling shook its branches and leaves up and down in agreement.
"Then what should I do?"
Ye Wuchen asked again.
The sapling didn't seem to know how to tell Ye Wuchen, and could only keep swinging its branches.
Simultaneously releasing increasingly intense emotions of desire.
Ye Wuchen then asked the saplings a few more questions.
But the saplings still just kept swinging their branches, seemingly unable to communicate.
Seeing that he couldn't find anything useful, he withdrew his mind from the Soul Palace.
Back to reality, Ye Wuchen looked at the demon pill in his hand, thinking about something in his heart.
In the Soul Palace, the sapling was still releasing the emotion of longing.
"Is it going to be refining?"
Ye Wuchen guessed.
As soon as he finished speaking, the sapling in his body actually released a burst of joy, as if he was acknowledging Ye Wuchen's words just now.
"It really needs to be refined."
Ye Wuchen was a little shocked.
Although there is a large amount of energy and blood power stored in the demon elixir, under normal circumstances no warrior would choose to refine the energy and blood power in the demon elixir.
The power of energy and blood contained in the demon pill is very violent, so the efficiency of refining the demon pill is very low.
Usually a demon pill can absorb 20% of the power of Qi and blood, which is considered good.
But the most important thing is that the power of qi and blood in the demon pill is often accompanied by demon poison.
If you want to absorb the refined demon pill, you will definitely inhale the demon poison into your body.
